materials.title: this / these、礼貌指令和 my / your

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: This ____ my notebook.
questions.evidence: This is my notebook.
questions.explanation: this 指一个笔记本，搭配 is；are 用于复数，am 用于 I，be 不能直接放在此处。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: These ____ my notes.
questions.evidence: These are my notes.
questions.explanation: these 指多个笔记，搭配 are；is 用于单数，am 用于 I，be 此处未变形。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.evidence: This is a textbook.
questions.explanation: 一个教科书用 this is；其他选项的 this/these 与 be 动词搭配错误。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: These ____ three markers.
questions.evidence: These are three markers.
questions.explanation: three markers 是复数，these 后用 are；is、am 和原形 be 不符合这个句子。

questions.prompt: Complete the instruction: Please ____ your notebook.
questions.evidence: Please open your notebook.
questions.explanation: 礼貌指令使用动词原形 open；opens、opening 和 opened 不能直接用作这个指令。

questions.prompt: Complete the instruction: Please ____ here.
questions.evidence: Please sit here.
questions.explanation: 请对方坐下时用原形 sit；sits 是第三人称单数，sitting 和 sat 不是此处的指令形式。

questions.prompt: Complete the instruction: Please ____ your name.
questions.evidence: Please write your name.
questions.explanation: please 后的指令动词用原形 write；writes、writing 和 wrote 不符合此句结构。

questions.prompt: Complete the instruction: Please ____ again.
questions.evidence: Please speak again.
questions.explanation: 请对方再说一遍时用原形 speak；speaks、speaking 和 spoke 不符合此处的指令结构。

questions.prompt: I talk about my own book: This is ____ textbook.
questions.evidence: my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的/你们的”；它们后面接名词。选项中 his 是“他的”，her 是“她的”，their 是“他们的”；先判断物品属于谁。
questions.explanation: 说话人谈自己的教科书，用 my；your、his、their 分别指你的、他的和他们的。

questions.prompt: The note belongs to Ben. I ask Ben: Is this ____ note?
questions.evidence: my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的/你们的”；它们后面接名词。选项中 his 是“他的”，her 是“她的”，their 是“他们的”；先判断物品属于谁。
questions.explanation: 说话人直接问 Ben 他的便条，用 your；my、her 和 their 指向其他所属关系。

questions.prompt: Ava says her own name: ____ name is Ava.
questions.evidence: my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的/你们的”；它们后面接名词。选项中 his 是“他的”，her 是“她的”，their 是“他们的”；先判断物品属于谁。
questions.explanation: Ava 在介绍自己的名字，句首用 My；其他选项不是“我的”。

questions.prompt: The marker belongs to Tom. I ask Tom: Is this ____ marker?
questions.evidence: my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的/你们的”；它们后面接名词。选项中 his 是“他的”，her 是“她的”，their 是“他们的”；先判断物品属于谁。
questions.explanation: 说话人直接询问 Tom 他的记号笔，用 your；my、her 和 their 不指代被问的 Tom。

materials.instructions: 先读中文解释和例句，做前 8 道引导题，再做 4 道新情境题；不确定时可回看规则。
materials.passage:
1. this 指近处的一个人或物，后面常用 is；these 指近处的多个物品，后面常用 are。先看名词是单数还是复数。
例句：This is my notebook. These are my notes. This is a textbook. These are three markers.

2. 给出简短指令时，句首使用动词原形；加 please 表示礼貌。动词不因对方是一个人或多人而加 -s。
例句：Please open your notebook. Please sit here. Please write your name. Please speak again.

3. my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的/你们的”；它们后面接名词。选项中 his 是“他的”，her 是“她的”，their 是“他们的”；先判断物品属于谁。
例句：My name is Sara. Your name is Ben.

materials.title: A Small English Group

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

questions.prompt: Who is the teacher?
questions.evidence: At ten, they meet their teacher, Ms Lee.
questions.explanation: 第一段说 Ms Lee 是老师；Sara 和 Ben 是学生，另一组学生没有被介绍为老师。

questions.prompt: How many students are in the group?
questions.evidence: There is a group of six students.
questions.explanation: 小组有六名学生，Sara 和 Ben 计入其中；三、四、五分别出现在其他物品的数量中。

questions.prompt: When do Sara and Ben meet Ms Lee?
questions.evidence: At ten, they meet their teacher, Ms Lee.
questions.explanation: 见老师的时间是十点；三、四和六是文中其他数量，不是这个时间。

questions.prompt: How many textbooks are on one table?
questions.evidence: Three textbooks are on one table.
questions.explanation: 一张桌上有三本教科书；四本是笔记本，五是便条上的名字数，六是学生人数。

questions.prompt: What does Ms Lee have?
questions.evidence: Ms Lee has a marker.
questions.explanation: 文中明确说 Ms Lee 有一支记号笔；没有说她拿着 Ben 的笔记本、那张便条或 Sara 的教科书。

questions.prompt: What does Ms Lee ask students to write?
questions.evidence: Please write your name in your notebook.
questions.explanation: 她请学生把自己的名字写在笔记本里；没有要求写五个问题、整张便条或桌子数量。

questions.prompt: What does the group read together?
questions.evidence: The group can read a short note together.
questions.explanation: 小组可以一起读一张短便条；其余三个内容没有被说成共同阅读材料。

questions.prompt: How many names are on the note?
questions.evidence: The note has five names.
questions.explanation: 短便条上有五个名字；三和四是书本数量，六是学生人数。

questions.prompt: Why does Ben ask Ms Lee to speak again?
options: He wants to leave the group.
He does not understand a sound.
answers: He does not understand a sound.
questions.evidence: I do not understand this sound. Please speak again.
questions.explanation: Ben 说自己不理解这个声音，请老师再说一次；没有说他找不到桌子、要离组或做完全部便条。

questions.prompt: What does Ms Lee show Ben?
options: The full list of six students.
questions.evidence: Ms Lee shows him the letters.
questions.explanation: Ben 问名字怎样拼写，老师给他看字母；原文没有说她向他展示教材、六人完整名单或桌子数。

materials.instructions: 先按小段读，圈出人物和数字；每题选择一个答案，回到原句核对。
materials.passage:
Sara and Ben are new students at an English class. At ten, they meet their teacher, Ms Lee. There is a group of six students. Sara and Ben are two of the six. Ms Lee says hello and shows them the room. The students can ask for help. There are two tables in the room. The group can sit at the tables. They have time to learn together. Ms Lee is happy to help the new students.

Three textbooks are on one table. Four notebooks are on another table. Sara has a notebook. Ben has one too. Ms Lee has a marker. She writes her name on the board. She says, "This is my name. Please write your name in your notebook."

Sara and Ben sit at a table. Ms Lee says, "Please open your textbook." The group can read a short note together. The note has five names. Sara reads one name. Ben reads another. They do not need to read very fast. The teacher can help them.

Ben has a question about a sound. He says, "I do not understand this sound. Please speak again." Ms Lee says the sound again. Ben tries it. He wants to check his answer. He asks, "How do you spell this name?" Ms Lee shows him the letters.

The students stand and speak to one another. Sara says, "I am fine. Thank you, Ms Lee." Ben says, "Thank you for your help." They write one more note and show it to the teacher. The group is small, and everyone has time to ask a question.

materials.title: A Different Group Meeting

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

questions.prompt: When does Ava’s group meet?
questions.evidence: We meet our English group at six.
questions.explanation: Ava 说她的小组六点见面；十点属于阅读中的另一组，四和三是听力里的数量。

questions.prompt: How many students are in Ava’s group?
questions.evidence: There are four students in this group.
questions.explanation: 听力小组有四名学生；三是教科书数量，五是便条上的名字数，六属于阅读小组。

questions.prompt: How many notebooks are on the table?
questions.evidence: Two notebooks are on this table.
questions.explanation: 这张桌上有两本笔记本；三本是教科书，四和五是其他数量。

questions.prompt: Who has the marker?
questions.evidence: The teacher has a marker.
questions.explanation: Tom 说老师有记号笔；没有说 Ava、Tom 或 Ben 拿着它。

questions.prompt: What can Ava and Tom write in their books?
questions.evidence: We can open our books and write our names.
questions.explanation: Ava 说他们可以打开书写自己的名字；没有提出写十个问题、地址或五个声音。

questions.prompt: Why does Tom ask Ava to speak again?
options: He wants to change the meeting time.
He does not understand one sound.
answers: He does not understand one sound.
questions.evidence: I do not understand one sound. Can you speak again, please?
questions.explanation: Tom 不理解一个声音，所以请 Ava 再说一遍；没有说要改时间、丢了书或换便条。

questions.prompt: What name does Ava help Tom spell?
questions.evidence: The name is Ben.
questions.explanation: Ava 说要拼写的名字是 Ben；Ava 和 Tom 是谈话者，Lee 没有被说成这个名字。

questions.prompt: Who does Tom ask to check his work?
questions.evidence: I ask the teacher to check my work.
questions.explanation: Tom 说他请老师检查作业；Ava 也说老师可以帮助他们，没有指定其他选项中的人检查。

questions.prompt: How long is the short task?
questions.evidence: We have ten minutes for a short task.
questions.explanation: 短任务有十分钟；三、四、五是其他数字，不是任务时长。

questions.prompt: How many names are on Tom’s note?
questions.evidence: I have five names on my note, but I read only one name first.
questions.explanation: Tom 的便条上有五个名字，他先只读一个；两个是笔记本数量，三个是教科书数量。

materials.instructions: 先按对话分段听人物与数字，再做题；音频尚未生成，当前文字仅供草稿审核。
materials.transcript:
Ava: Hello. My name is Ava. We meet our English group at six. There are four students in this group. What is your name?

Tom: My name is Tom. I am a new student too. Three textbooks are on that table. Two notebooks are on this table. The teacher has a marker.

Ava: Please sit here, Tom. This is my notebook. Is that your textbook? We can open our books and write our names. I can show you my note.

Tom: Yes, this is my textbook. I have a question. I do not understand one sound. Can you speak again, please? I want to check the sound before I read.

Ava: Yes. Listen to the sound. I can help you spell the name. The name is Ben. It has three letters. We can say the letters together.

Tom: Thank you, Ava. I can spell Ben now. I write the name in my notebook. I ask the teacher to check my work.

Ava: Yes. The teacher can help us. We have ten minutes for a short task. Please read the note and then stand near the group. We can speak to the other students. The teacher shows us the next part. We can listen together. It is fine to ask for help.

Tom: Thank you. I have five names on my note, but I read only one name first. Then we can ask the teacher another question.

guidedOutput.title: 写作步骤提示
guidedOutput.text: 先列出自己的名字、同学、一件学习物品及数量；每一步先写一两句短句，再连成完整内容。加入一句礼貌请求（Please ...）和互相帮助的方式；最后检查至少六个本课词。

materials.reference: My name is Sara. I am a student in an English group. This is Ben. He is my classmate. We meet at ten. I have a notebook and a textbook. Ben has a marker. Please open your notebook, Ben. I can show you a short note. There are three names on it. I have a question about one name. Ben, can you help me spell it? We speak again and check our work with the teacher. We do not need to be fast. Thank you for your help, Ben. I am fine in this small group.
